title: Equilibrium measures for anisotropic exponential interaction energies with applications to transformers
abstract: arXiv:2611.19518v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the minimization of anisotropic exponential interaction energies over probability measures on the sphere, motivated by mean-field models of self-attention in transformer architectures. For every symmetric positive definite interaction matrix, we relate the minimizer to a corresponding anisotropic Brownian motion and use the Feynman--Kac formula and elliptic regularity theory to show that it admits a smooth, strictly positive density on the sphere. We further show that it is the only stationary measure with full support for the dynamics considered. We use the stochastic viewpoint to derive an algorithm for sampling from the minimizer. In dimension two, we also propose a numerical scheme for approximating its density based on a Mathieu series expansion.

translated_title: 各向异性指数型相互作用能量的平衡测度及其在Transformer中的应用
translated_abstract: 我们研究球面上概率测度的各向异性指数型相互作用能量的最小化问题，其动机来自Transformer架构中自注意力机制的均场模型。对于任意对称正定的相互作用矩阵，我们将极小化子与相应的各向异性布朗运动联系起来，并利用Feynman–Kac公式与椭圆正则性理论证明该极小化子在球面上具有光滑且严格为正的密度。我们进一步证明，它是所考虑动力学中唯一具有全支撑集的平稳测度。借助随机过程的视角，我们导出了从该极小化子中采样的算法。在二维情形下，我们还提出了一种基于Mathieu级数展开的数值格式来逼近其密度。
tldr: 该论文针对Transformer自注意力机制的均场模型，证明了球面上各向异性指数型相互作用能量的极小化子具有光滑严格正的密度且是相应动力学唯一的全支撑平稳测度，并由此给出了采样算法及二维情形基于Mathieu级数的密度逼近方法。
en_tdlr: Motivated by mean-field models of self-attention in transformers, this paper proves that the minimizer of anisotropic exponential interaction energies on the sphere has a smooth, strictly positive density and is the unique full-support stationary measure, yielding a sampling algorithm and a Mathieu-series-based numerical scheme for its density in 2D.
